question: Estimate the cost to acquire a customer (CAC) for a major Indian e-commerce platform (Amazon / Flipkart).
idealClarificationQuestions: Blended new-customer CAC (across all channels)? Yes.
Definition: new customer = first successful order? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Amazon India marketing spend FY26: ~₹4,500-5,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: New customers added per year (Amazon): ~3-4 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Pure paid-acquisition CAC: ~₹400-700 per new customer.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~₹1,200-1,500 blended CAC; ~₹500-700 pure acquisition CAC.

calculationFlow: Amazon India marketing spend FY26: ~₹4,500-5,000 Cr.
New customers added per year (Amazon): ~3-4 crore.
But: this counts all marketing spend (including brand + retention); true paid acquisition CAC is lower.
Pure paid-acquisition CAC: ~₹400-700 per new customer.
Round: ~₹1,200-1,500 blended CAC; ~₹500-700 pure acquisition CAC.
